continuity_followup.study_status: Separate post-selection exploration; original U/E verdict and bytes untouched
continuity_followup.question: Does mere existence of heralded entanglement transmission through heterogeneous full-rank replacement/complete-thermalization channels qualify as a substantive advance beyond the cyclic depolarizing switch?
continuity_followup.reason: Existence in a neighborhood of the depolarizing point follows directly by continuity from the known strictly entangled heralded branch. Explicit published coverage of the heterogeneous thermal construction was not established because two supplied papers were inaccessible.

continuity_argument.channels: C_i(X)=Tr(X)*sigma_i, with sigma_i full rank; four cyclic orders and uniform control postselection
continuity_argument.known_point: All sigma_i=I/2: success p=7/16 and normalized Choi partial-transpose minimum eigenvalue -1/14
continuity_argument.dependence: Replacement Kraus operators can be chosen continuously using the positive matrix square root. The branch Choi operator, its nonzero success probability, normalized Choi operator, and partial-transpose eigenvalues are continuous near this point.
continuity_argument.strict_witness: Weyl continuity preserves negativity whenever the operator-norm perturbation of the normalized partially transposed Choi operator is less than 1/14. A sufficiently small neighborhood also preserves positive herald probability.
continuity_argument.heterogeneity: That neighborhood contains pairwise distinct full-rank states, including diagonal Gibbs states of the same qubit Hamiltonian at distinct sufficiently high finite temperatures. Hence a heterogeneous example is an immediate robust instance of the known capability.
not_proved: All full-rank replacement states at arbitrary temperatures work
A quantitative maximum temperature bias or low-temperature boundary
Finite-time thermalizing channels are replacement channels
Superiority over resource-matched definite-order coherent control

illustrative_synthetic_check.label: Continuity illustration only; no discovery claim

resource_comparator.finding: The paper treats arbitrary lists of replacement channels as free and allowed supermaps as signaling-non-generating. Such allowed supermaps preserve the replacement-channel class. Its no-forward-signaling condition therefore rules out attributing replacement-channel activation to a free communication transformation.
resource_comparator.qualification: This is a resource-model distinction, not a prohibition on physically implementing the familiar coherent-control construction, and not an explicit heterogeneous thermal-switch construction.

continuity_followup.remaining_claim_needed: A separated useful regime with a new construction and complete control, loss, heralding and channel-use comparator; neither isolated heterogeneous examples nor conditional fidelity alone suffices.
